traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets power. Relentless force and a 'win at any cost' edge, with real capacity to eliminate or transform. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Volcanic temper and a tendency to destroy work before it's finished. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for drive against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the drive/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: A power struggle becomes destructive when winning starts to matter more than protecting the outcome that caused the conflict.

readerCopy.body: A power struggle becomes destructive when winning starts to matter more than protecting the outcome that caused the conflict. When Mars squares Pluto, force and control press against each other, making escalation unusually easy to justify. Pushing harder can drain leverage without changing the underlying structure. The conflict is easier to judge once the remaining control, the actual stakes, and the cost of continuing are separated from pride.
